learned
Aga for the State, Sri Adarsh Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the informant

and 
perused the records.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.100 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Sonwa,
District Shravasti.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 11.07.2022 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter aged 17 years at about 02:00 p.m. on 04.07.2022.
The informant's wife had seen the applicant and the victim going on a motorcycle and she asked them to stop but the applicant did not stop.

sentences.text:
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that her family members had beaten her up and they were trying to get her married to some other person, therefore,
she had gone with the applicant and has married him.
Upon coming to know about FIR, she came back.
The victim was taken for medico legal examination but she declined to undergo the same.
Before the magistrate also in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim reiterated her earlier version.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the consistent statements of the victim where she has stated that she had gone with the applicant out of her own free will and she has married the applicant, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

Order Date :- 10.4.2025 Pradeep/-
